We need to propose retrosynthesis route up to 6 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <= $9999. Need to construct route using templates. We have some building blocks: sulfonyl chloride with fluorophenyl: O=S(Cl)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1 (p-fluorophenyl sulfonyl chloride). Also we have carbamate protected piperazine: O=C(N1CCN(C(=O)OC(C)(C)C)CC1)C? Actually earlier we checked O=C(N1CCN(C(=O)OC(C)(C)C)CC1)C which is N-acyl piperazine with t-Boc? That is maybe a carbamate attached to piperazine. Also we have a bicyclic phenol? The target has a fused ring system: C1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1 plus a phenyl sulfonyl attached to N of an aniline? Actually SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O. So sulfonamide linking sulfonyl group (with fluorophenyl) to an aniline that is part of polycyclic aromatic system. The polycyclic core is a dibenzofuran-like? Actually includes a cyclohexadienone? Hard.

We can think disconnection: sulfonamide formation between sulfonyl chloride (p-fluorophenyl sulfonyl chloride) and an aniline (the polycyclic amine). So step 1: sulfonyl chloride + aniline -> target sulfonamide.

Thus need to get aniline precursor: the polycyclic aromatic amine (aryl amine). The core: C1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1. That's a phenyl fused to a cyclohexanol ring with a pendant piperazine carbamate.

We can disconnect the piperazine carbamate via nucleophilic substitution of a halide on the aromatic ring? Actually the amine is attached directly to aromatic carbon (aryl amine). Could be formed via Buchwald-Hartwig coupling of aryl bromide with piperazine carbamate (protected). So we need aryl bromide precursor: the same core but with bromine instead of N-piperazine. So aryl bromide: C1=CC(Br)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1 with other fused ring? plus maybe other substituents.

Thus step 2: Buchwald-Hartwig coupling of aryl bromide with protected piperazine (e.g., N-Boc-piperazine). The protected piperazine is commercially available: N-Boc-piperazine (SMILES: O=C(O)C? Actually Boc is t-butoxycarbonyl: N-Boc-piperazine is (Boc)N1CCNCC1. SMILES: O=C(O)C(C)(C)C? Wait Boc group: (C(=O)OC(C)(C)C). So N-Boc-piperazine: O=C(OC(C)(C)C)N1CCNCC1. That's likely buyable.

Check buyability.
